summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K disclosing weekly share repurchases under a previously announced buyback program. Between June 22–26, 2026, it bought back 6,116,402 Class B shares at a weighted average price of SEK 110.4736 per share, totaling approximately SEK 675.7 million. The program size is up to SEK 15 billion, running from April 23, 2026 to March 31, 2027. Purchases were executed on Nasdaq Stockholm by Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE. The Board intends to propose cancellation of repurchased shares at the 2027 AGM, except those used for incentive programs. This is a routine capital return, not a tender offer, with no premium or special event.
